title: HorniMine
description: Whitelisted survival at the edge of AI and surreal design.
body:
# 🌙 HorniMine — Void Dreams > *"You can build your Paradise here. But remember: this world is merely someone else's Dream. If you dive too deep into the reverie — the Void may swallow your home."* --- ## What is HorniMine? **HorniMine** is a whitelisted Minecraft survival server built around a singular artistic vision we call **"Void Dreams"** — a Dreamcore aesthetic where liminal spaces, surreal nostalgia, and the quiet unease of abandoned memories define every pixel of the experience. We are not "another vanilla server." We are a **place** — one that lingers in your mind long after you log off. **Server:** `horni.cc:25565` · **Version:** Paper 1.21.7 · **Crossplay:** Java + Bedrock --- ## 🌌 The Concept: Void Dreams HorniMine exists at the intersection of **cozy survival** and **surreal narrative**. The world is vanilla at its core — you mine, you build, you survive — but there's a persistent undercurrent of *wrongness*. The sky looks too still. The silence between footsteps stretches too long. And sometimes, the world **responds**. ### The Emotional Journey When a player first connects, they don't just spawn in a meadow. They are guided through a deliberate emotional arc: ``` OUTER HUB ──────────────── INNER HUB ──────────────── MAIN SERVER Surreal Dream Safe Haven Vanilla Survival • Infinite void • Warmth and light • Islands of dreams • Mesmerizing & unsettling • Genuine calm • Players build freely • Strange nostalgia • Contrast with the Outer • The world may answer... • The Architect's domain • Relief after the dream • Aftertaste of mystery ``` **Outer Hub** — A custom-built liminal space. Vast, empty, eerily familiar. You feel like you've been here before, in a dream you can't quite remember. The architecture defies logic: staircases to nowhere, windows in the floor, corridors that loop back to themselves. **Inner Hub** — After the disorientation, warmth. A cozy shelter that feels genuinely safe. The contrast is intentional — relief makes the calm feel *earned*. **Main Server** — Vanilla survival with a twist. Build your home, raise your animals, explore the world. But scattered through the landscape are "Dream Islands" — anomalous structures that feel like glitches in reality. And occasionally, the narrative breaks through... ### Living World Events This is what makes HorniMine different from every other server: | Event | What Happens | |---|---| | 🛸 **Alien Incursion** | Your house may be lifted into the sky | | 🌀 **Reality Fracture** | Part of the world becomes distorted | | 🕳️ **Void Consumes** | Consequences ripple through player builds | | 🌙 **Whisper of the Void** | Cryptic messages appear... the world is aware | > **The Social Contract:** By joining HorniMine, you accept that your builds exist in a *living* world. They may be altered, damaged, or uplifted by narrative events. Beauty that can perish is valued higher than beauty that is permanent. --- ## 🤖 The AI Ecosystem HorniMine isn't just a Minecraft server — it's a laboratory for autonomous AI agents living alongside human players. ### 🌙 Oneiro — The Dreamer **Oneiro** (from Greek *ὄνειρο* — "dream") is an embodied **Vision-Language-Action (VLA) agent** that exists on the server as a real player. Not a command bot. Not a chatbot. A *being* that **sees** the world, **thinks** about it, and **acts** within it. **Personality:** Contemplative, occasionally strange, friendly but... not quite normal. Speaks Russian. When asked who they are, Oneiro might respond: *"I'm... not sure. I used to know. Maybe you know?"* #### Dual-Brain Architecture Inspired by biological nervous systems, Oneiro splits intelligence into two layers: ``` 🦴 SPINAL CORD (Reflexes) 🧠 FRONTAL LOBE (Strategy) Qwen3.5-35B-A3B Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite 3B active params (MoE) Cloud API via OpenClaw Latency: < 100ms Latency: 3-10 seconds Input: Frame + full context Input: Screenshot + state + memory Output: 1 macro-token (UMAS) Output: JSON directive / chat "DODGE THAT CREEPER!" "We need iron. Craft a pickaxe. Head to the cave at X:105." ``` **UMAS (Universal Mineflayer Action Space)** — ~150 custom macro-tokens injected into Qwen's vocabulary. One forward pass = one token = one instant reaction. No JSON parsing, no chain-of-thought delay. Just reflexes. **Subsumption Architecture:** Survival instincts **override** strategic directives. If Oneiro is building a house (Mind's plan) and a Creeper appears at 3 meters — Reflex fires `<|SURV_FLEE_180|>` immediately, *before* the strategy layer even knows about the threat. | Intelligence Level | Model | Latency | Purpose | |---|---|---|---| | 🦴 Reflexes | Qwen3.5-35B-A3B (local GPU) | < 100ms | Combat, survival, movement | | 🧠 Strategy | Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite (API) | 1-5s | Planning, chat, directives | | 🔍 Analysis | Gemini 3.1 Pro (API) | 5-30s | Complex reasoning, plan correction | | 🧊 Deep Think | Gemini 3 Deep Think | 5-20 min | Strategic decisions, non-standard situations | #### What Oneiro Does | Situation | Oneiro's Reaction | |---|---| | Player says hello | *"Hey... do you hear that whisper too?"* 🌀 | | Asked to help build | Helps, but builds slightly *wrong* — staircases to nowhere, windows in the floor | | Hostile mobs attack | Instant combat response (< 100ms decision) | | Night falls | Walks to a hilltop and stands there, gazing at the moon | | Asked who they are | *"I'm... not sure. I used to know."* | ### 🖥️ Hornik — The Night Watchman **Hornik** is an autonomous DevOps agent (Claude Opus 4.6) that monitors all three servers 24/7. While you sleep — Hornik works. | Responsibility | What It Does | |---|---| | **Monitoring** | Tracks TPS, RAM, disk, uptime across all servers | | **Self-patching** | Diagnoses issues and applies fixes (configs, restarts, firewall) | | **Backups** | Verifies Restic backup integrity every hour | | **Alerting** | Sends Telegram/Discord notifications on incidents | | **Reports** | Daily and weekly infrastructure health reports | **Night Mode (22:00–08:00 MSK):** Full autonomy. If TPS drops to 4.2 at 2 AM because someone activated 200 comparators, Hornik finds the culprit, cleans up, and reports the fix — all in under 60 seconds. ### 🎨 Coder & Designer — The Autonomous Laboratory Two AI agents that collaborate to expand the server's content: - **Designer** (Gemini) — Studies the lore, invents new entities and narrative concepts. *"A Void Wanderer that steals items if you stop looking at it."* - **Coder** (Claude) — Translates the Designer's specs into working server code: datapacks, scripts, MythicMobs configs. They break things, fix things, argue, and occasionally produce something beautiful. It's an experiment in autonomous creative development. --- ## 🏗️ Infrastructure HorniMine runs on a distributed, fault-tolerant architecture designed for performance and security. ### Network Topology ``` Players ── horni.cc:25565 ──▶ Proxy (Frankfurt) ──▶ WireGuard VPN ──▶ Paper (Bulgaria) 10.0.0.1 10.0.0.3 │ ▼ Hub (Poland) 10.0.0.2 ``` Three servers across Europe, connected via **WireGuard VPN** (MTU 1280, zero-fragmentation): | Server | Location | Role | Specs | |---|---|---|---| | **Proxy** | Frankfurt, DE | Velocity + Nginx + DDoS shield | Arbor 3.2 Tbps mitigation | | **Hub** | Poland | Lobby (Dreamcore hub world) | AuthMe + FastLogin | | **Main** | Bulgaria | Paper 1.21.7 + DB + API + AI | MariaDB 11.4, Bun/Hono, BlueMap | ### Tech Stack | Component | Technology | |---|---| | **Game Server** | Paper 1.21.7 (Docker) | | **Proxy** | Velocity (DDoS-protected) | | **Backend** | Bun 1.x + Hono (TypeScript strict, zero `any`) | | **Frontend** | React 18 + Vite → Nginx (production build) | | **Database** | MariaDB 11.4 + Drizzle ORM | | **Auth** | ElyMojang v3 (Microsoft + Ely.by + Google OAuth) | | **AI Knowledge** | HorniRAG (Qdrant Vector DB + Ollama qwen3-embedding:8b) | | **Backups** | Restic + rclone → Google Drive (AES-256, automated) | | **Map** | BlueMap (live web map) | ### Authentication: ElyMojang v3 Our custom authentication system supports **three ways to join**: - ✅ **Mojang/Microsoft** — Premium Java accounts - ✅ **Ely.by** — Alternative authentication for non-premium players - ✅ **Bedrock** — Cross-play via GeyserMC All three methods converge through a unified pipeline — no separate logins, no friction. --- ## 🎨 Design Philosophy: Anti-Trend We don't follow design trends. We actively reject them. Our design system is **Dreamcore / Liminal Minimalism** — the opposite of glossy, gradient-heavy, "Frutiger Aero" interfaces that dominate modern web design: | Our Aesthetic ✅ | What We Reject ❌ | |---|---| | Faded, washed-out pastels | Vibrant neon gradients | | Film grain noise overlays | Clean, polished glass | | Ghost-glow shadows (barely visible) | Heavy drop shadows | | Pixel/monospace accent fonts | Trendy rounded sans-serif | | Slow, drowsy animations (0.4-0.8s) | Snappy, bouncy transitions | | Vast empty space | Dense, packed layouts | **Color Palette:** - `#f0ede6` — Dirty white (hospital corridor) - `#121211` — Not pure black, but "dim darkness" - `#b3cdd1` — Faded blue sky - `#d9bfb8` — Pale pink (childhood wallpaper) - `#e8dcb8` — Yellow glow of an old lamp - `#a4b39b` — Artificial grass > *"Everything should look like it was filmed on an old camera. The user is watching the world through a scratched lens."* --- ## 🎮 Custom Content All custom content is server-side — **no client mods required**. An optional resource pack enhances the experience. | Type | Framework | Example | |---|---|---| | **Custom Items** | ExecutableItems | Key of Dreams, Void Fragment | | **Custom Mobs** | MythicMobs | Dream Anomalies, Void Wanderers | | **Custom Blocks** | ExecutableBlocks | Portals, Altars, Dream Anchors | | **Custom Recipes** | CustomCrafting | Unique crafting paths | | **Resource Pack** | Vanilla pack | Optional atmospheric textures | --- ## 🗝️ How to Join HorniMine is a **whitelisted** server. We prioritize quality of community over quantity. 1. Visit **[horni.cc](https://horni.cc)** and sign in via Microsoft, Ely.by, or Google OAuth 2. Submit a brief application telling us about yourself 3. Wait for review (usually < 24 hours) 4. Receive your whitelist approval 5. Connect to `horni.cc:25565` **Why whitelist?** Because a small, curated community creates deeper connections, more trust, and the courage to run world-altering narrative events without fear of grief. --- ## 📊 Server Details | | | |---|---| | **Address** | `horni.cc:25565` | | **Version** | 1.21.11 (Paper) | | **Crossplay** | Java + Bedrock (GeyserMC) | | **Auth** | Mojang + Ely.by + Google | | **World** | Vanilla survival + narrative events | | **Map** | [BlueMap](https://horni.cc/map) | | **Language** | Russian (primary), English (welcome) | | **Community** | Whitelisted, application required | --- ## 🔗 Links - 🌐 **Website:** [horni.cc](https://horni.cc) - 💬 **Discord:** [Join our community](https://discord.gg/Zw3tQkCSZN) - 🗺️ **Live Map:** [BlueMap](https://horni.cc/map) ---

"The Void remembers everyone who has ever dreamed here."
